ai_news.title: EU Council and Parliament Agree to Simplify AI Rules
ai_news.summary: The European Council presidency and Parliament reached a provisional agreement to streamline AI regulations, including postponing the deadline for national AI regulatory sandboxes to August 2027. The deal also shortens the grace period for providers to implement transparency solutions for AI-generated content from 6 months to 3 months. This marks a significant step in shaping the EU AI Act's enforcement landscape.
ai_news.relevance: This shapes how AI products and services will be governed and deployed across one of the world's largest regulatory jurisdictions.

ai_news.title: Global AI Adoption Rises to 17.8% of Working-Age Population — UAE Leads at 70.1%
ai_news.summary: Microsoft's Q1 2026 global AI diffusion report shows AI usage climbed from 16.3% to 17.8% of the world's working-age population. The UAE leads all nations at 70.1% adoption, while the United States climbed to 21st globally with a 31.3% usage rate. The report highlights widening gaps between AI-leading and AI-lagging nations.
ai_news.relevance: Tracks the real-world adoption velocity of AI across economies and reveals which countries are gaining or losing competitive ground.

ai_news.title: Stanford AI Index 2026: US and China Nearly Tied at Top of AI Performance Rankings
ai_news.summary: The 2026 Stanford AI Index reveals that China has nearly erased the United States' lead in AI model performance, with US and Chinese models trading places at the top of benchmarks multiple times since early 2025. As of March 2026, Anthropic's leading model holds only a 2.7% performance edge. The report covers 12 key takeaways about the current state of global AI.
ai_news.relevance: The narrowing US-China AI gap has major implications for technology leadership, national strategy, and enterprise AI procurement decisions.

ai_news.title: NVIDIA Unveils Open Isaac GR00T Models for Physical AI and Robotics
ai_news.summary: NVIDIA released new open Isaac GR00T models that enable robots to understand natural language instructions and execute complex multi-step tasks using vision-language-action reasoning. NVIDIA Cosmos world models also generate large-scale synthetic training data for robotics. The release was timed with National Robotics Week 2026 and positions physical AI as a major frontier.
ai_news.relevance: Open physical AI models lower the barrier to robotics development and accelerate the convergence of large language models with real-world automation.

ai_news.title: AI Energy Crisis: Data Centers Now Use as Much Power as the State of New York
ai_news.summary: AI data center power capacity has surged to 29.6 GW — roughly equivalent to powering the entire state of New York at peak demand. GPT-4o inference alone may consume water exceeding the drinking needs of 1.2 million people annually. The report identifies AI energy and water consumption as a critical sustainability challenge for the industry in 2026.
ai_news.relevance: The environmental footprint of AI infrastructure is becoming a key constraint on scaling, regulatory scrutiny, and corporate sustainability commitments.

sfdc_news.title: Salesforce Spring 2026 Release: Agentforce Builder and Agentic Enterprise Search Go Live
sfdc_news.summary: Salesforce's Spring 2026 release introduces Agentforce Builder, a conversational workspace for building and testing production-ready AI agents. The release also debuts Agentic Enterprise Search, which unifies search, collaboration, and action across 200+ external data sources powered by Data 360. Additional highlights include Agentforce Voice for Financial Services and a native Geographic Information System for field workers.
sfdc_news.relevance: Directly impacts how Salesforce customers can automate business workflows and deploy AI agents across sales, service, and field operations.

sfdc_news.title: Salesforce Acquires Qualified and Momentum to Expand Agentic AI and Revenue Intelligence
sfdc_news.summary: Salesforce signed definitive agreements to acquire Qualified, a provider of agentic AI marketing solutions, and Momentum, a conversational insights and revenue orchestration platform. The acquisitions are designed to let customers rapidly deploy AI-powered marketing and sales agents. These moves are part of Salesforce's broader FY26 Q4 strategic push into agentic automation.
sfdc_news.relevance: Expands Salesforce's AI agent capabilities into marketing and revenue orchestration, which could affect how teams using SFDC manage pipeline and campaigns.

sfdc_news.title: Braze Launches Full Two-Way Shopify Integration with Product Metafields for Deeper Personalization
sfdc_news.summary: Braze announced a complete two-way data flow with Shopify, enabling marketers to sync rich product attributes — including metafields, tags, and collections — directly into Braze for deeper personalization. This eCommerce enhancement also includes Content Optimizer, an AI-driven Canvas step that automatically generates and tests message variants. These updates are aimed at helping retail and eCommerce marketers move faster and improve campaign ROI.
sfdc_news.relevance: Strengthens Braze's position as a real-time CRM platform for eCommerce, enabling more granular customer segmentation and automated content testing.

sfdc_news.title: Amplitude Introduces Agentic AI Analytics with Global Agent and Specialized Product Agents
sfdc_news.summary: Amplitude launched a suite of AI agents that continuously monitor product usage, identify issues, and recommend actions in real time. The Global Agent lets teams ask complex analytics questions in plain language — it builds dashboards, investigates root causes, and takes action directly in Amplitude. The release also includes MCP integrations connecting Amplitude's behavioral data to tools like Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, Figma, and GitHub.
sfdc_news.relevance: Transforms Amplitude from a passive analytics tool into an active AI advisor, enabling product teams to get automated insights and recommended actions without manual analysis.

sfdc_news.title: Amplitude Launches AI Assistant: In-Product Support Agent with Behavior-Aware Walkthroughs
sfdc_news.summary: Amplitude introduced an embedded AI Assistant that guides users when they get stuck inside any product experience, offering context-aware responses and step-by-step walkthroughs. The assistant connects every support interaction to activation, retention, and conversion metrics in real time. Alongside this, Amplitude launched Agent Analytics — a new system to measure AI agent quality at scale and trace failures across prompts, tools, and context.
sfdc_news.relevance: Enables product teams to reduce drop-off and support costs by embedding intelligent, personalized guidance directly into their products while measuring its impact on business outcomes.
